authoring_self_audit.bounds: History maxHostAddresses including removed/rejected keys; copied routers/cooldowns maxCandidateRouters/address; cooldown overflow address-wide, no live eviction; existing saturated deadlines/retry engine reused.
authoring_self_audit.effective_path: RA capability/context processing -> assignment enrollment -> LL registration -> global copied NS -> actual registrar/DAR/DAC/NA -> acceptance -> LowpanIpv6 native data guard.
authoring_self_audit.high_risk: By-value finishCopy prevents erased-reference use; copied previous acceptance applies only solicited3; async pending cancellation preserves a different accepted tuple; initiating router must be valid before TID allocation; listener payload borrowed synchronously; exact assignment clears only its rejection.
authoring_self_audit.identity: Global history IPv6 key; LL interface+IPv6 key; full owner separate from actual/wire EUI; one TID increment per admitted logical transaction, never per copy/retry.
authoring_self_audit.indivisibility: Host history/state machine, source validation, wire copies, lifecycle callbacks and data eligibility are active callers/terminal consumers of one feature and must land together.
authoring_self_audit.owner: Existing LowpanHostRegistration helper owns bounded histories, one logical transaction/address, frozen registrar copies and existing host timer; ND owns gates/signals/lifecycle.
authoring_self_audit.protection: All six assigned production paths explicitly unsealed. Generic/core/domain/context/Info inputs unchanged by host feature.
authoring_self_audit.siblings: Default legacy automatic host and updated scripted registrar/race plus P10 controls executed. Common egress and unsolicited sender prerequisites have independent parent-owned proof.
authoring_self_audit.terminals: Success, zero, duplicate, solicited3, asynchronous Moved, status9, timeout, capability/source expiry, assignment removal/re-add and STOP/START retain or clear only their specified owner state.
